title: Bitcoin Multi-Factor Regime Modeling
subtitle: A multi-signal framework for identifying Bitcoin market regimes and dynamically adjusting exposure.
summary_bullets: Researched 10+ heterogeneous Bitcoin alpha signals spanning valuation, on-chain positioning, miner economics, investor sentiment, and technical momentum, including MVRV, Holder Profitability, Fear & Greed, Puell Multiple, Hash Ribbons, and trend/momentum indicators.

Developed a multi-signal regime-classification framework to identify low-, intermediate-, and high-valuation market states and dynamically adjust exposure rather than relying on static buy-and-hold positioning.

Backtested the regime-based allocation strategy across multiple market cycles, growing initial capital to 2.82× with 18.6% maximum drawdown, versus 2.68× and 58.4% maximum drawdown for Bitcoin buy-and-hold.

Evaluated signal persistence, regime stability, turnover, drawdown behavior, and robustness across parameter specifications, with emphasis on distinguishing genuine predictive information from highly correlated on-chain and technical indicators.
